switching.reversed_contrast: raw on the 808 lowest-local-contrast full frames, and separately the 41 lowest-contrast keyframes with 767 other lowest-contrast frames
switching.test: detector-specific plus-one Monte Carlo tail fraction; shared masks across detectors, no pooled 72-count inference

reference.outlier_sensitivity: flag reference edges above median + 6 scaled MAD; exclude their closed frame intervals from fit and test; all-reference primary remains unchanged

dense_evaluation.common_sets: identical fresh frames for every member of each comparison; calendar windows held fixed
dense_evaluation.bootstrap: 1000 paired contiguous segment-block replicates at block lengths 1,2,3; pool SSE/sample counts

cutoff_probe.saved_long_gap: 169 consecutive supplied-reference pairs across 9 configurations, at cutoffs 50 and 1e9
cutoff_probe.new_short_gap: 169 current IDs 20,40,...,3380 and their attempted anchors from the completed ORB fixed high-depth run
cutoff_probe.essential_estimate: one per source/pair reused at all cutoffs
cutoff_probe.anchor_schedule: held fixed; intermediate cutoffs are gate probes rather than reintegrated VO
cutoff_probe.groups: accepted at both 50 and 1e9; accepted only at 1e9; default-only separately; selected and source-specific
cutoff_probe.scope_note: As-built exploratory protocol; short-gap grid chosen to avoid an unnecessary full re-estimation

seed_replicates.intervention: legacy OpenCV RANSAC uses a fixed local RNG; global seed changes alone are ineffective, so matched arrays are jointly permuted to change sampled hypotheses and probe order/tie effects
seed_replicates.trials: one ordered baseline plus four seeded permutations
seed_replicates.scope: 16 new full estimator outputs; no AKAZE/SIFT sampling generalization
